split_tensor_along_last_dim: split a PyTorch tensor into equal partitions along its last dimension
ensure_divisibility: assert that a numerator is evenly divisible by a given denominator
divide: perform integer division after asserting the numerator is divisible by the denominator
vocab_range_from_per_partition_vocab_siz: compute the first and last vocabulary index for a given rank and partition size
vocab_range_from_global_vocab_size: compute the vocabulary index range for a rank given global vocab size and world size
